name: MEGA
description: Plays your MEGA cloud drive in Jellyfin. Files are decrypted on the fly (end-to-end encryption kept), libraries are virtual so nothing is downloaded ahead, playback starts fast and seeks with parallel connections, and MEGA previews are used as thumbnails. Works with MEGA accounts (e-mail, 2FA, or MEGAcmd session) and public folder links.
overview: Stream your MEGA cloud drive: decryption on the fly, virtual libraries, fast seeking

versions.changelog: Embedded subtitles of MEGA MKV files no longer make Jellyfin read the whole file. When a client cannot take them with the video (Chromecast and Android TV transcodes, the web player, burned-in text), the plugin reads only the subtitle blocks through the MKV index (cues) and fills Jellyfin's subtitle cache: a few seconds and a few MB per file instead of minutes and gigabytes of transfer quota. Fixes subtitles that never load and playback errors on Chromecast.

Faster playback start, transcode and seek on MEGA files (Chromecast, Android TV): ffprobe and ffmpeg analyse 10 seconds of a MEGA file instead of 200. Files with PGS subtitles no longer read about 350 MB at each playback start and seek.

Fix login when MEGA asks for a proof of work: retries resend the same request, as the official MEGA apps do; the computation is time-boxed, can be cancelled and runs at low priority. Login now runs in the background and the settings page shows its progress, so reverse-proxy timeouts no longer break it.
